book.name: Tutui Makasososak
book.title: Tutui Makasososak Mulai numa Manetualain nakadadadik lalai no dae-inak

content: Yakob no nufanelun nara rahehere fo rae reni Masir reu
Basa boe ma Yakob

asa rafafaꞌu bua-baꞌun nara, de ara laꞌo ela Kanaꞌan. Losa nggorok Barseba, boe ma ana tunu-hala banda fo tao tunu-hotuk fee Manetualain, fo ndia aman Isak nakaluku-nakatele neun numa fai bakahulun mai.
Leꞌodaek esa boe ma ana nala meꞌi. Nai meꞌis dale, ana namanene Manetualain nanggoun nae, “Yakob! O mambadeik dei, fo nenene!” Boe ma ana naselu nae, “Tao hata, Manetualain!”

Boe ma Manetualain nae, “Au ia Manetualain fo o amam nakaluku-nakatele neun numa fai bakahulun mai ena. O boso mamataꞌu muni Masir muu, huu neu ko Au tao o tititi-nonosim dadi neu hatahori nusa moꞌok nai naa.
Neu ko Au uni Masir uu sama-sama ua o. Ma neu ko Au oo ua falik o tititi-nonosim mara reni dae Kanaꞌan mai boe. Neu ko neu faik fo o mate, o anam Yusuf hambu o ani hahaem.”
Basa boe ma Yakob no anan nara
laꞌo ela nggoro Barseba. Ara fua Yakob no sao-anan nara reu karetar fo manek Masir haituak ena.
Boe ma ara haꞌi reni basa sira pusakan nara, ma basa banda-manun nara fo sira ue rala numa dae Kanaꞌan ena. Yakob no ndia ana toun, ana inan, ma basa umbu-usin nara lalaꞌen laꞌo reni Masir reu.
Yakob nufanelun fo mana tungga reni Masir reu
Yakob nufanelun nara fo mana tungga lali reni Masir reu, sira:

content.text: Anan nara sira: Henok, Palu, Hesron, ma Karmi.
Simeon, no anan nara, sira: Yemuel, Yamin, Ohad, Yakin, ma Sohar. Ma Saul, ndia anan numa saon, ina Kanaꞌan mai.
Lewi no anan nara, sira: Gerson, Kehat, ma Merari.
Yahuda no anan nara, sira: Sela, Peres, ma Sera. Yahuda anan laen Er, ma Onan, mate sara ruma Kanaꞌan ena. Ana oo neni Peres anan nara boe, sira: Hesron ma Hamul.
Isaskar no anan nara, sira: Tola, Pua, Ayub, ma Simron.
Sebulon no anan nara, sira: Sered, Elon, ma Yahleel.

content: Sira basa sara raa, Yakob no saon Lea ana bonggin nara, neu ara leo numa Mesopotamia. Hambu sira ana inan esa bali, nade Dina. De Yakob no Lea tititi-nonosin nara basa sara, sira hatahori 33.

content.text: Boe ma hambu anan nara ruma saon laen mai, sira: Gad, no anan nara: Siflon, Hagi, Suni, Esbon, Eri, Arodi ma Areli.
Aser no anan nara, sira: Yimna, Yiswa, Yiswi, Beria, ma sira feton, nade Sera.
Hambu Beria anan nara boe: Heber no Malkiel.

content: Sira basa sara, hatahori 16, fo Yakob no ndia saon Silpa umbu-anan nara. Silpa naa, ina mana malalau uma-loo fo Laban feen neu ana inan Lea, Yakob sao ulun.

content.text: Boe ma hambu Yakob saon laen bali, nade Rahel. Ana bonggi nala anak dua, sira: Yusuf no Benyamin.
Lelek naa, Yusuf sao nala Asnat numa Masir ena. Ndia ari-aman naa, malangga anggama numa Kota On. Ndia naden Potifera. Yusuf no Asnat anan nara, sira: Efraim ma Manase.
Benyamin oo tungga Masir neu no anan nara boe, sira: Bela, Beker, Asibel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Ros, Mupim, Hupim, ma Ared.

content: De Yakob no saon Rahel tititi-nonosin naa, hambu hatahori 14.

content.text: Basa naa, bei hambu Yakob saon esa bali, nade Bilha. Dua sara anan nara, sira: Dan no Naftali.
Naftali no anan nara, sira: Yasel, Guni, Yeser, ma Silem.

content: Yakob no saon Bilha tititi-nonosin naa, hambu hatahori 7. Bilha naa, Rahel ina mana malalau uma-loon fo ana hambun numa ndia papan Laban mai.
De basa Yakob tititi-nonosin nara mana reni Masir reu, hambu hatahori 66. Bei ta reke no ndia mane-feun ma feto-feun nara.
Tamba no Yusuf anan nara fo bonggi sara ruma Masir, sira dua. De Yakob no nufanelun nara fo mana leo numa Masir, basa sara hatahori 70.
Yakob natonggo falik no anan Yusuf
Neu ara sangga deka Masir ena, Yakob nadenu anan Yahuda laꞌok nakahuluk, fo neu noke Yusuf mai natonggo noon nai Gosen. Neu ara losa Gosen ena,
boe ma Yusuf saꞌe karetan, fo neu natonggo no aman numa naa. Neu ara ratonggo, boe ma Yusuf holu nala aman, de ana buꞌi nala doon seli.
De Yakob kokolak nae, “Anang Yusuf, ee! Hatematak ia au mesa ngga mete-ita o ena. Ma au bubuluk ena o bei masodak. Huu naa de leo mae au mate hatematak ia oo malole boe.”
Basa boe ma Yusuf nafada basa ndia kaꞌa-fadin nara nae, “Au muste uu afada manek ae, au nufanelung nggara ruma Kanaꞌan mai ena.
Dei fo au afada ae, eir ia hatahori mana makaboi bibi lombo ma sapi. Huu naa de ei oo meni ei banda-manum ma pusakam mara ruma Kanaꞌan mai boe.
Mete ma manek noke ei, ma ana natane nae ei masiꞌe tao ue-osa hata,

na, ei maselu neun mae, ei basa ngga ia, mana makaboi banda-manu numa kadiꞌi anam mai, sama leo ei bei-baꞌim mara. No dalak naa, neu ko ana nadenu ei leo miu dae Gosen.” Yusuf nafada talo naa, nahuu hatahori Masir asa nunute, mete ma ara leo rakabua ro mana lolo bandar.

footnotes.text: Susura Malalaok dedeꞌa Ibrani nae, “Israꞌel nafafaꞌu, boe ma laꞌo.”
Susura Malalaok dedeꞌa Ibrani surak nae, “Israꞌel anan nara laꞌo ro sira aman, Yakob.”
Susura Malalaok dedeꞌa Ibrani surak nae “Israꞌel nufanelun”.
